title: product.created
description: Published by products-service (RabbitMQ product.exchange, routing key product.created). Consumed by inventory-service (creates its own stock row) and orders-service (a minimal ownership projection, capturing only productId/sellerId -- see orders-service's own ProductCreatedEvent.java for why). price: known limitation, not covered by this schema -- products-service/orders-service use BigDecimal, inventory-service (Go) uses float64; JSON Schema's number type cannot distinguish fixed-point from floating-point precision (same caveat ADR-0002 already recorded).
